_note: Round 61 (scripts/systems/FloorRun.gd): the pull of one more floor. Robert: 'make game play more enjoyable, immersive and compulsive.' A floor's tally from the moment you arrive; a graded card when its master falls (a better grade than before pays the difference); a descent streak for going down floor after floor without falling or turning back. Dev writes the verdict lines (brief floor_verdicts); these are ours until then.

S: Every corner walked, every lock tried, and you never once bled for it. The deep noticed.
Fast, thorough, untouched. I have watched a thousand go down. Few like that.
Nothing here is hidden from you now. Go on -- the next one is waiting.
A: Thorough and sure-footed. A corner or two left for next time.
Little missed, little lost. Keep that pace.
You fought well and looked hard. Not quite everything -- nearly.
B: You got what mattered. There's more here, if you come back.
No shame in it. The chests you passed are still there.
A fair floor. Look behind the walls next time.
C: You made it down. You walked past half of what this place had.
Quick, but you left a lot behind. The deep rewards a patient eye.
Through, with gaps. Spirit sense finds what eyes miss.
D: That was close. Rest, mend your gear, and walk this floor again when you're ready.
Barely. Sit at a shrine, then come back and take what you missed.
You lived. Next time, guard more, chase less, and look around.
